mapper.select: SELECT CAST(SUBSTRING(s.target_year_month, 1, 4) AS UNSIGNED) AS year, CAST(SUBSTRING(s.target_year_month, 5, 2) AS UNSIGNED) AS month, s.target_contract_count AS targetCount, COUNT(c.id) AS contractCount, case when s.target_contract_count IS NULL OR s.target_contract_count = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(count(c. contract_result_status_code) / s.target_contract_count * 100, 1) END AS achievementRate FROM sales_monthly_target s LEFT JOIN contract c ON s.sales_user_id = c.sales_user_id AND c. contract_result_status_code = '02' WHERE s.sales_user_id = #{id} AND s.target_year_month = #{targetYearMonth} GROUP BY s.target_year_month, s.target_contract_count;

WITH customer_base AS ( SELECT pc.id AS customer_id, '01' AS customer_type_code, pc.name AS customer_name, pc.gender, pc.birth_date, pc.sales_user_id, pc.consult_status_code, pc.insurance_age_shift_date, pc.created_at FROM potential_customer pc WHERE pc.conversion_status_code = '01' AND pc.sales_user_id = #{salesUserId}
UNION ALL
SELECT ic.integrated_customer_id AS customer_id, '02' AS customer_type_code, ic.name AS customer_name, ic.gender, ic.birth_date, ic.sales_user_id, NULL AS consult_status_code, ic.insurance_age_shift_date, ic.created_at FROM integrated_customer ic WHERE ic.sales_user_id = #{salesUserId} ),
representative_contract AS ( SELECT * FROM ( SELECT c.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY c.insured_id ORDER BY CASE c.contract_result_status_code WHEN '01' THEN 1 WHEN '02' THEN 2 WHEN '03' THEN 3 ELSE 9 END, c.updated_at DESC, c.id DESC ) AS rn FROM contract c INNER JOIN customer_base cb ON cb.customer_id = c.insured_id ) x WHERE x.rn = 1 ),
latest_webform AS ( SELECT * FROM ( SELECT wr.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY wr.conversion_status_code, wr.customer_id ORDER BY wr.received_at DESC, wr.id DESC ) AS rn FROM webform_response wr INNER JOIN customer_base cb ON cb.customer_type_code = wr.conversion_status_code AND cb.customer_id = wr.customer_id ) x WHERE x.rn = 1 ),
latest_report AS ( SELECT * FROM ( SELECT cr.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY cr.conversion_status_code, cr.customer_id ORDER BY cr.created_at DESC, cr.id DESC ) AS rn FROM customer_report cr INNER JOIN customer_base cb ON cb.customer_type_code = cr.conversion_status_code AND cb.customer_id = cr.customer_id ) x WHERE x.rn = 1 ),
representative_three_step AS ( SELECT * FROM ( SELECT dai.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY dai.conversion_status_code, dai.customer_id ORDER BY dai.target_date ASC, dai.id DESC ) AS rn FROM daily_action_item dai INNER JOIN customer_base cb ON cb.customer_type_code = dai.conversion_status_code AND cb.customer_id = dai.customer_id WHERE dai.is_completed = FALSE AND dai.trigger_type_code IN ('06', '07', '08') ) x WHERE x.rn = 1 ),
customer_enriched AS ( SELECT cb.*,
rc.id AS contract_id, rc.contract_status_code, rc.contract_result_status_code, rc.insurance_product_id, rc.insured_id,
lw.id AS webform_id, lw.received_at AS webform_received_at,
lr.id AS report_id, lr.send_status_code,
rts.trigger_type_code AS three_step_code, rts.target_date AS three_step_target_date
FROM customer_base cb LEFT JOIN representative_contract rc ON rc.insured_id = cb.customer_id LEFT JOIN latest_webform lw ON lw.conversion_status_code = cb.customer_type_code AND lw.customer_id = cb.customer_id LEFT JOIN latest_report lr ON lr.conversion_status_code = cb.customer_type_code AND lr.customer_id = cb.customer_id LEFT JOIN representative_three_step rts ON rts.conversion_status_code = cb.customer_type_code AND rts.customer_id = cb.customer_id ),
customer_page AS ( SELECT ce.*, DATEDIFF(ce.insurance_age_shift_date, CURDATE()) AS age_increase_d_day,
CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(ce.insurance_age_shift_date, CURDATE()) BETWEEN 0 AND 30 THEN 1 WHEN ce.three_step_code IS NOT NULL THEN 2 WHEN ce.webform_id IS NOT NULL THEN 3 ELSE 9 END AS sort_rank
FROM customer_enriched ce WHERE 1 = 1
AND ce.customer_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{customerName}, '%')
AND TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, ce.birth_date, CURDATE()) = #{age}
AND ce.gender = #{gender}
AND ce.contract_status_code IN
#{code}
AND ce.report_id IS NOT NULL
AND ce.report_id IS NULL
AND ce.three_step_code IS NOT NULL
AND ce.three_step_code IS NULL
ORDER BY sort_rank ASC, age_increase_d_day ASC, ce.three_step_target_date ASC, ce.created_at DESC
LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset} )
SELECT cp.customer_id AS customerId, cp.customer_name AS customerName, cp.gender AS gender, TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, cp.birth_date, CURDATE()) AS age, cp.birth_date AS birthDate,
cp.customer_type_code AS customerStageCode,
CASE cp.customer_type_code WHEN '01' THEN '잠재 고객' WHEN '02' THEN '통합 고객' END AS customerStageName,
cp.insurance_age_shift_date AS insuranceAgeShiftDate, cp.age_increase_d_day AS ageIncreaseDDay,
cp.three_step_code AS threeStepCode, COALESCE(trigger_code.code_name, '-') AS threeStepName,
cp.consult_status_code AS consultStatusCode, COALESCE(consult_code.code_name, '-') AS consultStatusName,
cp.contract_id AS contractId, cp.contract_status_code AS contractStatusCode, COALESCE(contract_code.code_name, '미상담') AS contractStatusName,
COALESCE(ip.product_name, '-') AS insuranceName,
COALESCE( CASE WHEN cp.customer_type_code = '01' THEN pc_insured.name WHEN cp.customer_type_code = '02' THEN ic_insured.name END, cp.customer_name) AS insuredName,
CASE WHEN cp.webform_id IS NULL THEN '-' ELSE DATE_FORMAT(cp.webform_received_at, '%Y/%m/%d') END AS webformReceivedAt,
cp.report_id AS reportId,
CASE WHEN cp.report_id IS NULL THEN FALSE ELSE TRUE END AS hasReport,
cp.send_status_code AS reportStatusCode,
CASE WHEN cp.report_id IS NULL THEN '미발송' ELSE COALESCE(send_code.code_name, '미발송') END AS reportStatusName,
CASE WHEN cp.report_id IS NULL OR cp.send_status_code != '02' THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS canSendReport,
cp.sort_rank AS sortRank
FROM customer_page cp
LEFT JOIN potential_customer pc_insured ON cp.customer_type_code = '01' AND pc_insured.id = cp.insured_id
LEFT JOIN integrated_customer ic_insured ON cp.customer_type_code = '02' AND ic_insured.integrated_customer_id = cp.insured_id
LEFT JOIN insurance_product ip ON cp.insurance_product_id = ip.id
LEFT JOIN common_code trigger_code ON trigger_code.group_code = 'TRIGGER_TYPE' AND trigger_code.code_value = cp.three_step_code
LEFT JOIN common_code consult_code ON consult_code.group_code = 'CONSULT_STATUS' AND consult_code.code_value = cp.consult_status_code
LEFT JOIN common_code contract_code ON contract_code.group_code = 'CONTRACT_STATUS' AND contract_code.code_value = cp.contract_status_code
LEFT JOIN common_code send_code ON send_code.group_code = 'SEND_STATUS' AND send_code.code_value = cp.send_status_code
ORDER BY cp.sort_rank ASC, cp.age_increase_d_day ASC, cp.three_step_target_date ASC, cp.created_at DESC
